speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
text: asked the Prime Minister whether the Public Service Division will be considering a one-time wage adjustment for all civil servants to offset the anticipated high core inflation rate in 2022.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: Minister was saying that with the recent adjustments in the civil service pay, every civil servant will get at least more than 5.1% of the salary increment because the core inflation rate in October is 5.1%?

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: At the same time, we notice that there is a report in The Straits Times to say that about 68% of the employees were thinking of changing jobs if their pay is not increased more than the inflation rate.

speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
text: But that is a very, very small number of people who do not meet the performance criteria.
